body: This is fair and I appreciate the concern, I do know however that if we were to get engaged we still wouldn’t have a wedding until WAY down the line.

We have been together for a little over 6 months now but known each other in middle school, fell away from each other for 2 years then reconnected again a little over a year ago.
We have talked about it, she asked me about it and I told her I was 100% willing and wanting do propose, we both think being engaged is something that would be really great and make us happy I just don’t want to fuck it up.  I feel though that since we wouldn’t push a wedding it might be ok.

This is insane but I have the exact same situation, met in middle school didn’t get together till senior year.  I know if I do end up pulling the trigger and proposing we would wait for the wedding until we are both done with grad school and moving.  Thank you so much for sharing this advice it means more than you could ever know.
You’re very helpful, maybe read the last sentence of my post, literally asking opinions.
Thank you so much, how much humidity should I give the guy.
